title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
title_zh: Work2Skill：捕捉人类GUI经验以实现可重用的智能体技能诱导

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework’s infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67 4.67 – 10.54 10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11 3.11 – 7.50 7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill .
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体能够执行越来越复杂的 GUI 任务，但对于不熟悉且需要人类领域知识的软件和操作流程，它们仍然面临挑战。 人类的演示通过相同的 GUI 交互空间传递程序性知识，但若要复用这些知识，则需要在特定上下文中解读操作，并将工作流程规则与任务特定的细节区分开来。 因此，我们提出了 Work2Skill——一个能够捕捉人类 GUI 经验并用于可复用智能体技能诱导的框架。 WorkRecorder 为该框架提供了收集此类经验所需的基础设施，能够对屏幕录制、鼠标和键盘事件以及可用的无障碍树信息进行同步对齐。 借助 WorkRecorder，我们构建了 WorkDemo-350——首个针对人类桌面 GUI 演示的同步多模态数据集，可用于可复用智能体技能诱导及下游评估。 该数据集包含的 350 项演示均经过筛选，以确保其完整性和任务成功性。 接着，我们提出了一种智能体技能诱导方法，该方法可根据需要检查证据，从而生成能够捕捉工作流程规则、步骤依赖关系和完成检查的可复用技能。 当相同的四种执行模型在共享的执行设置下配备由每种方法诱导出的技能时，Work2Skill 取得了最高的得分和成功率。 与相应的“无技能”基线相比，平均得分分别提升了 4.67 – 10.54 分和 3.11 – 7.50 分（分别对应 MyPCBench Bounded Action 测试集和 OSWorld-Verified 中一个包含 286 个任务的子集）。 我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill 获取。

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex desktop and web tasks, supported by advances in GUI grounding and planning ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Agashe et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Yet agents still struggle with unfamiliar software and workflows that require domain knowledge, where successful execution depends on procedures not spelled out in the user’s request ( Zhang et al., 2026e ; Jang et al., 2026 ) . For example, “submit my reimbursement” does not specify which internal portal to use, which receipts to attach, or what to check before submission. Agents need this user- or organization-specific procedural knowledge to translate a user’s goal into GUI actions.
paragraphs.zh: 借助 GUI 基础与规划技术的进步，计算机使用智能体能够执行越来越复杂的桌面和网页任务（Qin 等人，2025；Agashe 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2025a）。 然而，智能体在面对需要领域知识的不熟悉软件和工作流程时仍存在困难，因为成功执行取决于用户请求中未明确说明的步骤（Zhang 等人，2026e；Jang 等人，2026）。 例如，“提交我的报销申请”这一指令并未说明应使用哪个内部门户、需要附上哪些收据，或提交前需要检查哪些内容。 智能体需要这些由用户或组织特定的程序性知识，才能将用户的目标转化为 GUI 操作。

paragraphs.en: Human demonstrations offer a direct source of this knowledge because humans and computer-use agents share the same GUI interaction space. Demonstrated controls, action sequences, and visible outcomes can therefore guide an agent’s own execution. Prior work converts demonstrations into expert instructions and semantic action traces ( Li et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) , multimodal tutorials ( Bai et al., 2026 ) , or reusable skills ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction (Figure 1 ). Its three components address the following challenges in action grounding, method comparison, and evidence inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 人类的演示提供了这种知识的直接来源，因为人类和计算机使用智能体共享相同的 GUI 交互空间。 因此，演示的控制操作、动作序列和可见的结果可以指导智能体自身的执行过程。 先前的研究将演示转化为专家指令和语义动作轨迹（Li et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026e）、多模态教程（Bai et al., 2026）或可重用的技能（Yang et al., 2026a; Xiao et al., 2026）。 OpenAI 的“记录与重播”（OpenAI, 2026b）和 Claude 的“记录一项技能”（Anthropic, 2026a）将这种方法引入面向用户的工具中。 因此，我们提出了 Work2Skill——一个能够捕捉人类 GUI 经验以用于智能体技能可重用感知的框架（图 1）。 其三个组件分别解决了动作落地、方法比较和证据检验方面的以下挑战。

sents.en: Its three components address the following challenges in action grounding, method comparison, and evidence inspection.
sents.zh: 其三个组件分别解决了动作落地、方法比较和证据检验方面的以下挑战。

paragraphs.en: First, action coordinates reveal where an operation occurred but not what the target control means. ShowUI-Aloha interprets actions from full-screen frames and target crops ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) , while Demo2Tutorial uses before-and-after screenshots ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . Without accessibility-tree (AX) evidence, these parsers depend on visual grounding to infer target semantics; selected frames can also miss transient states and intermediate operations. WorkRecorder addresses this ambiguity by aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available AX information. Recorded element names and roles provide explicit control semantics, while linked video preserves the surrounding state changes. The induction agent can thus interpret an operation using both its visual context and available structured UI evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，动作坐标揭示了操作发生的位置，但并未说明目标控制的具体含义。 ShowUI-Aloha 通过全屏帧和目标裁剪来解析动作（Zhang et al., 2026e），而 Demo2Tutorial 则使用前后对比的截图（Bai et al., 2026）。 在没有可访问性树（AX）证据的情况下，这些解析器依赖视觉定位来推断目标语义；所选帧也可能遗漏瞬态状态和中间操作。 WorkRecorder 通过将屏幕录制、鼠标和键盘事件以及可用的 AX 信息对齐，解决了这种模糊性。 记录的元素名称和角色提供了明确的控制语义，而关联的视频则保留了周围的状态变化。 因此，归纳智能体可以利用视觉上下文和可用的结构化 UI 证据来解释一项操作。

paragraphs.en: Second, representative desktop GUI studies use different demonstrations, task sets, and execution protocols ( Zhang et al., 2026e ; Bai et al., 2026 ) . Their results mix differences in induction with differences in source experience and evaluation conditions. WorkDemo-350 provides a common demonstration resource for skill induction in desktop environments. Collected with WorkRecorder, it contains 350 human GUI demonstrations covering 64 MyPCBench Bounded Action tasks ( Jang et al., 2026 ) and a 286-task OSWorld-Verified subset ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . Each demonstration is screened for completeness and task success and packaged with synchronized visual and action evidence, plus available AX information. This shared evidence and a controlled downstream protocol support comparisons of induction methods using the same task evaluators and execution conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，典型的桌面 GUI 研究采用了不同的演示、任务集和执行协议（Zhang 等人，2026e；Bai 等人，2026）。 他们的结果将归纳能力的差异与源经验及评估条件的差异混为一谈。 WorkDemo-350 为桌面环境中的技能归纳提供了一个通用的演示资源。 该资源通过 WorkRecorder 收集，包含 350 条人类 GUI 演示，涵盖 64 个 MyPCBench 受限动作任务（Jang 等人，2026）以及一个包含 286 个任务的 OSWorld-Verified 子集（Xie 等人，2024）。 每条演示都经过完整性与任务成功率的筛选，并附带同步的视觉与动作证据，以及可用的 AX 信息。 这些共享的证据以及受控的下游协议，支持使用相同的任务评估者和执行条件对归纳方法进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Third, representative pipelines prescribe an order for action parsing and procedure abstraction, even when individual stages refine their outputs ( Zhang et al., 2026e ; Bai et al., 2026 ) . This couples evidence inspection to predefined stages. Loading a long recording into context at once also creates context pressure, while selecting a fixed subset can omit details needed later. Our agentic skill-induction method addresses both constraints by interleaving on-demand evidence inspection with skill writing and revision. Drawing on active evidence acquisition in agentic video understanding ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , the agent selects linked files, images, and video intervals to resolve questions as they arise. It can revisit the source after drafting without loading the entire recording at once. During skill writing, we guide the agent to generalize demonstration-specific inputs into task-dependent descriptions while preserving procedural rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. The skills guide execution without the source recording.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the resulting skills through downstream execution on the WorkDemo-350 tasks. Using official evaluators and a shared text-guidance interface, we compare Work2Skill with No Skill and text-adapted versions of ShowUI-Aloha and Demo2Tutorial. paragraphs.en: Human demonstrations provide experience for GUI agents across desktop, web, and mobile environments ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) . Procedural representations include expert instructions ( Li et al., 2025 ) , task graphs ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , and parameterized workflows for robust replay ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . LearnAct also introduces LearnGUI for evaluating demonstration-based learning on mobile devices ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Reusable guidance draws on experience organization and evidence selection. Skill-induction methods learn procedures through autonomous interaction ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) or distill execution and user traces ( Mi et al., 2026 ; Ni et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026c ) , with environment feedback and policy learning supporting further refinement ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) . Adaptive memories, contextual playbooks, and learned memory-management routines retain experience ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , while experience-based evaluation examines its downstream value ( Peng et al., 2026 ) . Guidance from multimodal demonstrations requires choosing what to inspect. Agentic video methods retrieve and examine relevant segments iteratively ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . In GUI settings, CUADebug inspects traces and screenshots to diagnose execution failures ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) , while MMSkills packages textual procedures, state cards, and keyframes for selective inspection during execution ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .

paragraphs.en: WorkRecorder collects the evidence needed to interpret human actions in context. Given a task instruction, a human demonstrator performs the task in the benchmark’s official environment. WorkRecorder captures screen video, keyframe images, mouse and keyboard activity, and available UI information as multimodal evidence (Figure 3 ). An action trace links each recorded operation to its supporting evidence so that the induction agent can inspect individual steps. Task setup and outcome evaluation follow the corresponding benchmark procedures.
paragraphs.zh: WorkRecorder 收集了用于在特定情境中解释人类行为所需的证据。 给定任务说明后，人类演示者会在基准测试的官方环境中执行该任务。 WorkRecorder 会捕捉屏幕视频、关键帧图像、鼠标和键盘活动以及可用的用户界面信息，作为多模态证据（图 3）。 一条操作轨迹将每个记录的操作与其对应的支持性证据关联起来，以便归纳智能体能够检查各个步骤。 任务设置与结果评估均遵循相应的基准测试流程。

paragraphs.en: WorkRecorder aligns input events and visual observations on a common video-relative timeline. It groups timestamped events into actions such as clicks, drags, scrolling, and hotkeys, then links these actions to keyframes. An agent can therefore inspect a click alongside its screen image, available target information, and surrounding video to determine what changed. Target-element association uses pointer location and event timing, with window context and control semantics helping select among candidates. On Linux, AT-SPI point queries and nearby accessibility events supply available names, roles, and bounds for click and drag records. UI annotations are derived from the corresponding target elements in the AX tree. AX snapshots provide additional interface context but need not reflect the exact action-time state. Appendix A details the recording architecture, capture policies, target-matching rules, and time alignment.
paragraphs.zh: WorkRecorder 将输入事件和视觉观察对齐到统一的视频相对时间线上。 它将带有时间戳的事件分组为点击、拖拽、滚动和热键等动作，然后将这些动作与关键帧关联起来。 因此，智能体可以将一次点击与其屏幕图像、可用目标信息以及周围视频一同检查，以确定发生了什么变化。 目标元素的关联基于指针位置和事件时间，窗口上下文和控制语义有助于在候选项中进行选择。 在 Linux 系统中，AT-SPI 点查询和附近的无障碍事件为点击和拖拽记录提供了可用名称、角色和边界信息。 UI 注释源自 AX 树中对应的目标元素。 AX 快照提供了额外的界面上下文，但不一定反映动作发生时的确切状态。 附录 A 详细描述了录制架构、捕获策略、目标匹配规则和时间对齐方法。

paragraphs.en: WorkDemo-350 provides a common evidence resource for studying skill induction. Collected with WorkRecorder, it contains 350 human GUI demonstrations: 64 MyPCBench Bounded Action tasks and a fixed 286-task OSWorld-Verified subset. The two benchmarks provide complementary settings. MyPCBench ( Jang et al., 2026 ) covers personal office and everyday workflows with user-specific context; its Bounded Action tasks offer scoped GUI workflows suited to human demonstration. OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) adds general computer-use tasks across desktop and web applications, broadening the range of workflows available for skill induction and evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We screen tasks and recordings to retain successful, high-quality demonstrations. For OSWorld-Verified, we first exclude infeasible tasks for which a valid human demonstration cannot be completed. Across both benchmarks, demonstrators follow valid GUI workflows and verify the final state without being restricted to a prescribed action sequence. We then review task success and recording completeness, discarding demonstrations that omit key operations or end in an incorrect state (Appendix E ). Each episode links task and action records to available visual and UI evidence.

paragraphs.en: Skill induction turns an evidence episode into reusable procedural guidance. Given the task instruction and recorded evidence, a NexAU tool-using agent ( Nex-AGI, 2026 ) generates skills in an output directory separate from the recordings. The default system prompt is concise: it sets evidence-access boundaries, prerequisite checks, and completion requirements while leaving the detailed exploration and revision sequence to the agent. A bundled skill-creator policy guides skill authoring. After reading this policy and the task definition in task.json , the agent alternates evidence inspection with skill writing and revision. Appendix D provides the prompts and authoring policy.

paragraphs.en: We select file, image, and video tools that expose complementary views of a demonstration at different granularities. File discovery and reading provide task definitions, manifests, action traces, key logs, and available structured UI evidence. Traces and indices link operations to their supporting media, while AX records supply available control names and roles. read_visual_evidence returns selected images with source-path labels, exposing visible controls and entered or selected values. Video tools provide access to states and transitions beyond the indexed images. After reading video metadata, the agent can sample an interval with watch_video or request individual timestamps with extract_video_frames ; both return timestamp-labeled frames. Source-path and timestamp labels preserve the correspondence between returned observations and source artifacts. Appendix C details the interfaces, and Section 4.5 evaluates the contribution of the available evidence to downstream execution.

paragraphs.en: The agent chooses its next observation according to the task and unresolved questions in the evidence, following iterative inspection in agentic video understanding ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . The prompt requires representative initial, critical, and final-state images to be inspected when indexed images are available; the agent otherwise determines the inspection sequence and level of detail. For example, an ambiguous click can prompt inspection of the target frame to identify the control, followed by a later video frame to check the resulting state. Tool guidance encourages coarse video sampling followed by closer examination of relevant actions. Evidence inspection and skill writing share one conversation, so a draft can expose missing constraints or unverified transitions. The agent can then return to the relevant evidence and revise the procedure to incorporate supported dependencies and completion checks. Candidate skills are not executed during induction, and downstream evaluation results are not used as revision feedback. When the available observations do not resolve an uncertainty, the authoring policy requires an observable conditional check or an explicit limitation in the skill. Section 4.5 compares this prompt with Pipeline Prompt, which sets exploration order but allows further inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体根据任务以及证据中尚未解决的问题，按照智能体视频理解中的迭代检查流程选择下一个观察项（Yang et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）。 当有索引图像可用时，提示要求检查具有代表性的初始状态、关键状态和最终状态的图像；否则，由智能体确定检查顺序和细节程度。 例如，一次模棱两可的点击可能触发对目标帧的检查以识别控制项，随后再检查后续视频帧以确认结果状态。 工具引导鼓励先进行粗略的视频采样，然后对相关动作进行更细致的检查。 证据检查与技能编写共享同一对话，因此草案可以暴露缺失的约束条件或未经验证的状态转换。 智能体随后可以返回相关证据，并修订流程以纳入已证实的依赖关系和完成度检查。 候选技能在归纳阶段不会被执行，下游评估结果也不会被用作修订反馈。 当可用观察项无法消除不确定性时，编写策略要求执行可观察的条件检查，或在技能中明确设置限制。 第 4.5 节将本提示与 Pipeline Prompt 进行了比较：后者设定了探索顺序，但允许进一步检查。

paragraphs.en: The agent expresses each coherent reusable capability in a SKILL.md , with YAML frontmatter containing its name and description, following the Agent Skills file convention ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Through the authoring policy, we guide the agent to generalize demonstration-specific inputs into task-dependent descriptions and describe UI targets semantically. The policy instructs the agent to keep phases together when they share state, task-derived data, quantities, or required ordering, and to retain selection rules, calculations, dependencies, requested scope, stop conditions, visible completion checks, and supported recovery. Skills must preserve visible GUI interaction and include all instructions needed for execution without the source recording. Before completion, the agent calls finalize_extraction to validate output structure and required tool use. Checks cover task-file access, required skill structure, a recorded write followed by a read of each final skill, and metadata inspection before video sampling. Successful finalization records skill hashes, inspected source paths, validation results, and run provenance. These checks verify output structure and required tool use; they do not verify skill correctness or task success. For downstream evaluation, the executor receives the target task instruction and generated skill. It selects GUI actions using this guidance together with its observations and action history, without accessing the source recording. Sections 4.4 and 4.3 evaluate reuse across execution models and task instances. Appendix D.4 details the authoring policy and output requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在 SKILL.md 文件中表达每一项连贯且可重用的能力，其中 YAML 前导元数据包含其名称和描述，遵循“智能体技能”文件规范（Zhang 等，2025）。 通过编写策略，我们引导智能体将演示特定的输入泛化为任务相关的描述，并以语义方式描述用户界面目标。 该策略指示智能体在共享状态、任务衍生数据、数量或所需顺序时保持各阶段的整体性，并保留选择规则、计算、依赖关系、请求范围、停止条件、可见的完成检查以及支持恢复机制。 技能必须保留可见的用户界面交互，并在不依赖源记录的情况下包含执行所需的所有指令。 在完成之前，智能体调用 finalize_extraction 以验证输出结构和所需的工具使用。 检查涵盖任务文件访问、所需技能结构、一次记录写入后对每个最终技能的读取，以及在视频采样前的元数据检验。 成功完成会记录技能哈希、已检验的源路径、验证结果和运行来源。 这些检查用于验证输出结构和所需的工具使用，但不会验证技能的正确性或任务的成功性。 对于下游评估，执行器接收目标任务指令和生成的技能。 它基于此指导以及自身的观察和行动历史来选择用户界面操作，而无需访问源记录。 第 4.4 节和第 4.3 节评估了跨执行模型和任务实例的重用情况。 附录 D.4 详细说明了编写策略和输出要求。

paragraphs.en: We organize our experiments around the following four research questions. RQ1 tests whether the induced skills improve execution on the demonstrated tasks. RQ2 and RQ3 then examine two dimensions of reuse: changes to task requirements and changes to the execution model, respectively. RQ4 investigates how the available evidence and induction prompt affect downstream utility. A case study illustrates how induced skills handle dependent subgoals in a multistep workflow.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate skills as plug-in guidance by appending their text as a clearly delimited block to the end of the executor’s base system prompt. All text-guidance methods use the same <task_skills> wrapper; Appendix D.5 gives the template and injected contents. Separating procedural guidance from the execution loop supports reuse across execution models and integration with different agent harnesses. We therefore use shared execution settings for each model and benchmark, varying only the appended guidance to control for differences in native agent pipelines. We compare Work2Skill with No Skill, action semantics from ShowUI-Aloha (Aloha) ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) , and tutorial text from Demo2Tutorial (D2T) ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . The demonstration-based methods use the same source episodes, while their input modalities and evidence representations follow each method’s design. RQ1 thus compares their overall ability to produce useful guidance under shared execution conditions; RQ4 separately examines evidence and induction-prompt choices within Work2Skill while holding the model and skill-authoring policy fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将技能作为插件式指导进行评估，具体方法是将它们的文本作为一个明确界定的模块附加在执行器的基础系统提示末尾。 所有文本指导方法均使用相同的 <task_skills> 包装器；附录 D.5 提供了模板和注入内容。 将程序性指导与执行循环分离，有助于在不同执行模型之间重复使用，并支持其与不同智能体框架的集成。 因此，我们对每个模型和基准测试都使用共享的执行设置，仅通过改变附加的指导内容来控制原生智能体流程的差异。 我们将 Work2Skill 与 No Skill、来自 ShowUI-Aloha（Aloha）（Zhang et al., 2026e）的动作语义以及来自 Demo2Tutorial（D2T）（Bai et al., 2026）的教程文本进行比较。 基于演示的方法使用相同的源事例，但它们的输入模态和证据表示遵循各自方法的设计。 因此，RQ1 比较了它们在共享执行条件下生成有用指导的整体能力；RQ4 则在固定模型和技能编写策略的前提下，单独考察 Work2Skill 中证据和归纳提示的选择。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of induced skills in downstream GUI execution, we compare Work2Skill with No Skill and the text-adapted ShowUI-Aloha and D2T baselines on the demonstrated tasks under shared execution settings (Table 2 ). Relative to the higher-scoring of the two demonstration-based baselines for each execution model, Work2Skill improves Score by 3.95 3.95 – 7.79 7.79 points on MyPCBench and 1.65 1.65 – 6.96 6.96 points on the evaluated OSWorld-Verified subset. For GPT-5.5 on MyPCBench, SR reaches 48.44 % 48.44\% , compared with 37.50 % 37.50\% for both Aloha and D2T. Compared with No Skill, Work2Skill improves the average score by 4.67 4.67 – 10.54 10.54 points and the success rate by 6.25 6.25 – 25.00 25.00 percentage points on MyPCBench. On the evaluated OSWorld-Verified subset, the corresponding gains are 3.11 3.11 – 7.50 7.50 score points and 1.40 1.40 – 7.69 7.69 percentage points.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether induced skills generalize beyond the demonstrated instance, we evaluate the original skills on tasks with changed requirements within the same application, without further induction. MyPCBench Jitter contains one paired variant of each of the 64 original tasks, changing entities, parameters, or constraints within the same application context. For example, a flight-booking variant changes the destination, travel date, and seat preference. GPT-5.6-sol assists in revising task instructions and evaluation criteria, followed by human verification (Appendix E.1 ). Each of the four models directly reuses the skills induced for the original tasks on their paired variants.

paragraphs.en: To assess how evidence and prompts affect downstream skill utility, we ablate the available input modalities and separately compare the Work2Skill and Pipeline Prompt system prompts. UI annotations contain metadata and descriptions derived from the corresponding action targets in the AX tree. paragraphs.en: With the evidence held fixed, we next test whether a prescribed sequence of induction stages helps the agent use it. Pipeline Prompt specifies the induction stages and their order: read the task and artifacts, inspect images and video, then write, review, and finalize skills. paragraphs.en: To illustrate how extracted skill guidance affects execution, we compare GPT-5.5 supplied with outputs from ShowUI-Aloha, D2T, or Work2Skill through the shared text interface (Section 4.1 ). Each method extracts its guidance from the same human demonstration. Figure 6 shows a Cotogna booking for ten people with three fallback restaurants and two favorites. The fallbacks must be handled before confirmation, while preserving the date, party size, and requested note. With ShowUI-Aloha or D2T guidance, the executor completes the primary booking but leaves fallback inspection, favoriting, and persistence checks incomplete, scoring 55 / 100 55/100 in both conditions. With the skill induced by Work2Skill, it satisfies all eight rubric items ( 100 / 100 100/100 ). The generated skill makes intermediate requirements explicit: it rechecks fields that may reset during navigation, excludes the primary restaurant from the fallback set, and defers final confirmation until the fallback steps are complete. The skill preserves dependent subgoals across navigation and checks both the reservation and saved favorites before declaring completion (Appendix F.2 ).

paragraphs.en: We presented Work2Skill, a framework for capturing human GUI experience and converting it into reusable agent skills. WorkRecorder collects aligned multimodal evidence, WorkDemo-350 organizes 350 curated demonstrations, and agentic skill induction combines on-demand evidence inspection with iterative skill writing and revision. Across four execution models, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates among the compared methods on MyPCBench Bounded Action and the evaluated OSWorld-Verified subset. Further experiments support reuse under changed task requirements within the same application and transfer between the tested models. These results highlight the value of aligned human demonstrations and flexible evidence exploration for building reusable procedural guidance that computer-use agents can apply through a shared text interface without accessing the original recordings or other demonstration evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Work2Skill，一个用于捕捉人类 GUI 体验并将其转化为可重用的智能体技能的框架。 WorkRecorder 收集对齐的多模态证据，WorkDemo-350 整理出 350 个精心挑选的演示，而智能体技能归纳则将按需证据检查与迭代式技能编写和修订相结合。 在四种执行模型中，Work2Skill 在 MyPCBench Bounded Action 和所评估的 OSWorld-Verified 子集上，相较于其他方法获得了最高的得分和成功率。 进一步的实验表明，该方法支持在同一应用程序内任务要求变化时的技能复用，以及在不同测试模型之间的迁移。 这些结果凸显了对齐的人类演示和灵活的证据探索在构建可重用流程指导方面的价值，计算机使用智能体可以通过共享的文本接口应用这种指导，而无需访问原始记录或其他演示证据。

sents.en: These results highlight the value of aligned human demonstrations and flexible evidence exploration for building reusable procedural guidance that computer-use agents can apply through a shared text interface without accessing the original recordings or other demonstration evidence.

paragraphs.en: WorkRecorder consists of a native macOS recording application, a local service for capture coordination and storage, and accessibility providers. In local macOS mode, the application records the selected screen region and input activity, with available accessibility evidence supplied by the macOS provider. For a remote Linux workflow, recording remains on the Mac, while an AT-SPI collector runs inside the target desktop session. The Linux launcher connects this collector to the local service through an SSH tunnel; the remote-desktop client supplies the displayed workflow. Task initialization and official benchmark evaluation are handled separately from recording.

paragraphs.en: The macOS application records a selected screen region through ScreenCaptureKit and encodes video with H.264. CoreGraphics event taps supply mouse and keyboard activity, which is also grouped into semantic operations. The operator can pause, resume, stop, and review a recording. Full keystroke capture is disabled by default; when enabled, it records key presses and releases, characters, modifiers, and timestamps. Otherwise, ordinary typing is represented through aggregate typing events. The capture policy therefore determines the detail available in the input stream.
paragraphs.zh: 该 macOS 应用程序通过 ScreenCaptureKit 记录选定的屏幕区域，并使用 H.264 编码视频。 CoreGraphics 的事件点击提供了鼠标和键盘的活动信息，这些信息也会被分组为语义操作。 操作员可以暂停、恢复、停止和查看录制内容。 默认情况下，完整的按键捕捉功能是禁用的；启用后，它会记录按键按下与释放、字符、修饰键以及时间戳。 否则，普通的输入操作将通过汇总的输入事件来表示。 因此，捕捉策略决定了输入流中可用的细节程度。

paragraphs.en: The Linux collector supports X11/Xorg desktops and uses AT-SPI to obtain Accessibility Trees, interface events, and target UI elements. Its default periodic tree sampler runs every two seconds, with limits of six levels and 400 nodes; these are implementation defaults rather than dataset collection settings. Events may reference the latest completed tree snapshot, with its sampling timestamps. Target-element queries return available names, roles, and bounds at a screen location. The recorder maps positions in the displayed remote-desktop region to Linux desktop coordinates for these queries. Availability depends on application accessibility support and sampling limits.

paragraphs.en: When resolving clicks from accessibility snapshots, the resolver considers nodes whose bounds contain the click coordinate. It ranks these candidates by node confidence and interactive role, with an area penalty favoring smaller controls. Resolution records retain the selected source, confidence, and evidence anchor; uncertain cases can remain flagged for review.
paragraphs.zh: 在解析无障碍快照中的点击事件时，解析器会考虑其边界包含点击坐标的节点。 它会根据节点置信度和交互角色对这些候选项进行排序，并通过区域惩罚机制优先选择较小的控件。 解析记录会保留所选来源、置信度和证据锚点；不确定的情况可继续标记以供审查。

paragraphs.en: The remote Linux probing path is triggered by clicks and drags. Configured remote-display geometry maps local pointer positions to Linux desktop pixels; positions outside the displayed desktop do not trigger a point probe. The AT-SPI watcher combines bounded point queries with nearby focus, selection, and state-change events. Its point-query ranking prioritizes active windows, named interactive controls, other named nodes, greater depth, and smaller area, in that order. Event correlation normally checks whether the target bounds contain the pointer position, with additional handling for transient controls such as menus that disappear after selection. Pointer-resolution records retain the originating pointer sequence identifier and distinguish resolved, coarse, unresolved, and error or timeout outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 远程 Linux 探测路径由点击和拖动操作触发。 已配置的远程显示几何结构将本地指针位置映射到 Linux 桌面的像素；位于显示桌面区域之外的位置不会触发点探测。 AT-SPI 监视器将有限范围的点查询与附近的焦点、选择和状态变化事件相结合。 其点查询排序优先顺序依次为：活动窗口、有名称的交互式控件、其他有名称的节点、更深的层级以及更小的区域。 事件关联通常会检查目标边界是否包含指针位置，并对菜单等临时控件（在选中后会消失）进行额外处理。 指针解析记录保留原始指针序列标识符，并能区分已解析、粗略、未解析以及错误或超时等结果。

paragraphs.en: During export, recorded probe results are associated with actions using their trigger’s monotonic timestamp and action kind, with a nearest-action fallback within 2.5 seconds. In normal export mode, a missing click or drag target can also be recovered from the nearest specific accessibility event within a 3-second window. This backfill excludes generic page or window focus and uses each candidate event at most once. For drags, the matching anchor is the drag start, computed from the release time and recorded duration. Backfilled records retain their source, event identifier, and time offset. These are heuristic temporal associations; the matching windows are implementation tolerances, not measured accuracy bounds. Keyboard input does not trigger this Linux target probe. AX snapshots are attached independently as interface context.
paragraphs.zh: 在导出过程中，记录好的探针结果会依据其触发事件的单调时间戳和行动类型与行动关联，并在 2.5 秒内通过最近行动进行回补。 在正常导出模式下，如果点击或拖拽目标缺失，也可以从 3 秒窗口内的最近特定无障碍事件中恢复该目标。 这种回补不包括通用的页面或窗口焦点变化，且每个候选事件最多只使用一次。 对于拖拽操作，匹配锚点是拖拽起点，其位置通过释放时间和记录时长计算得出。 回补后的记录会保留其来源、事件标识符和时间偏移量。 这些是启发式的时间关联；匹配窗口属于实现上的容差范围，而非测量精度的界限。 键盘输入不会触发这种 Linux 目标探针。 AX 快照作为接口上下文独立附加。

paragraphs.en: WorkRecorder selects keyframes primarily around recorded operations and interface transitions. Recording start, stop, pause, and resume provide boundary frames, while users can explicitly mark additional frames. Routine candidates are triggered by clicks, drag releases, scroll completion, recognized hotkeys, command submission, and window or tab switches. A typing pause can trigger a frame when text is submitted or a typing milestone is reached; the default milestone requires at least eight characters or input events in the typing segment. Individual key presses and releases do not independently trigger screenshots. Additional enabled policies can request frames at scroll milestones or when a provider reports an error or warning surface.
paragraphs.zh: WorkRecorder 主要围绕已记录的操作和界面切换来选择关键帧。 开始、停止、暂停和恢复录制会提供边界帧，同时用户也可以显式标记额外的帧。 常规候选帧由点击、拖拽释放、滚动完成、识别到的热键、命令提交以及窗口或标签页切换触发。 当文本被提交或达到输入里程碑时，输入暂停可以触发一个帧；默认里程碑要求输入段中至少包含八个字符或输入事件。 单独的按键按下和释放不会独立触发截图。 其他启用的策略可以在滚动里程碑处请求帧，或在提供商报告错误或警告界面时请求帧。

paragraphs.en: For clicks, hotkeys, and window or tab switches, the recorder can reuse a recent preceding keyframe as before-action context, with a default freshness limit of 1.5 seconds. A new before-action capture requires an explicit pre-action event; otherwise this context can remain unavailable. Result frames use a bounded settling window to allow the interface to respond. With adaptive polling enabled, capture can proceed when a provider reports readiness or when visual or text observations stabilize after a detected change; the default stability rule requires two consecutive stable samples. Waiting limits depend on the action type. If settling times out, the policy can capture the available state and flag it for review, or suppress the candidate. Thus, a result-frame link does not by itself establish that the interface has finished updating.
paragraphs.zh: 对于点击、热键以及窗口或标签页的切换操作，记录器可以像之前一样重用最近的前一个关键帧作为“操作前”上下文，其默认的新鲜度限制为 1.5 秒。 新的“操作前”捕获需要明确的操作前事件；否则，该上下文将无法使用。 结果帧会采用一个有界的稳定窗口，以便界面能够做出响应。 在启用自适应轮询的情况下，当提供者报告已就绪时，或者在检测到变化后视觉或文本观察结果趋于稳定时，捕获都可以继续执行；默认的稳定规则要求连续两个样本保持稳定。 等待限制取决于操作类型。 如果稳定过程超时，策略可以捕获当前可用的状态并标记以供审查，或者抑制该候选项。 因此，仅凭一个结果帧的关联本身并不能确定界面已经更新完成。

paragraphs.en: The planner removes duplicate triggers within an action’s timing plan. The scheduler applies a minimum gap between separate plans, limits result frames per action, and enforces capture budgets. When change or quality signals are available, it can also reject candidates with insufficient change or information gain. Defaults include a 500-ms gap, at most two result-related candidates per action, and a session budget of 64 keyframes; required boundary frames and explicit user marks have exemptions. These are implementation defaults, not verified settings for every collected demonstration. Retained keyframes carry identifiers and timestamps, while trigger decisions retain acceptance or rejection reasons. Frame reuse and candidate filtering mean that actions and keyframes need not have a one-to-one correspondence. Exported image counts are distinguished from recorded keyframe counts in Appendix B .

sents.en: The planner removes duplicate triggers within an action’s timing plan.
sents.zh: 规划器会移除某个动作的时间计划中重复的触发器。

sents.en: The scheduler applies a minimum gap between separate plans, limits result frames per action, and enforces capture budgets.

sents.en: Defaults include a 500-ms gap, at most two result-related candidates per action, and a session budget of 64 keyframes; required boundary frames and explicit user marks have exemptions.
sents.zh: 默认设置包括 500 毫秒的间隔、每个动作最多两个与结果相关的选择项，以及 64 个关键帧的会话预算；必需的边界帧和明确的用户标记不受此限制。

paragraphs.en: The recorder maps evidence onto the stitched video’s timeline. Native input uses a monotonic timestamp anchored to the first captured frame of each recording segment, rather than the time at which recording was requested. Remote Linux events use wall-clock timestamps, which are projected onto the same timeline using the corresponding first-frame wall-clock anchors and segment durations. Segment offsets account for pause/resume boundaries; remote events falling within a pause have no corresponding video frame. The Linux launcher checks host clock agreement before recording and rejects a difference greater than two seconds. This check is a deployment condition, not a measured alignment-error bound. Legacy recordings without first-frame wall-clock anchors use the session start as a fallback.
paragraphs.zh: 记录器将证据映射到拼接视频的时序线上。 本地输入使用单调时间戳，该时间戳以每个录制片段的首个捕获帧为锚点，而非请求录制的时间。 远程 Linux 事件使用墙钟时间戳，并通过对应的首帧墙钟锚点和片段时长将其投影到同一时序线上。 片段偏移量会考虑暂停/恢复的边界；发生在暂停期间的远程事件没有对应的视频帧。 Linux 启动器在开始录制前会检查主机时钟是否一致，若差异超过两秒则拒绝录制。 此检查是部署条件，而非经过测量的对齐误差界限。 缺少首帧墙钟锚点的旧版录制会使用会话开始时间作为替代方案。

sents.zh: 片段偏移量会考虑暂停/恢复的边界；发生在暂停期间的远程事件没有对应的视频帧。

sents.en: The Linux launcher checks host clock agreement before recording and rejects a difference greater than two seconds.
sents.zh: Linux 启动器在开始录制前会检查主机时钟是否一致，若差异超过两秒则拒绝录制。

sents.en: This check is a deployment condition, not a measured alignment-error bound.
sents.zh: 此检查是部署条件，而非经过测量的对齐误差界限。

sents.en: Legacy recordings without first-frame wall-clock anchors use the session start as a fallback.
sents.zh: 缺少首帧墙钟锚点的旧版录制会使用会话开始时间作为替代方案。

paragraphs.en: The induction agent reads a per-task episode directory containing the task and its recorded evidence. The task file must contain the authoritative instruction and task inputs; a placeholder with only an inferred task ID is insufficient for induction. The converter excludes the grading field from this file.

sents.zh: 归纳智能体读取每个任务的剧集目录，其中包含该任务及其记录的证据。

paragraphs.en: When present, evidence/manifest.json and evidence/image_actions.jsonl provide the image index and its input-event and trajectory associations. sents.en: The manifest distinguishes action records, input events, recorded keyframes, and exported evidence images.
sents.zh: 该清单区分了动作记录、输入事件、已记录的关键帧以及导出的证据图像。

sents.en: Table 1 reports mean counts of action records and exported images per episode.

paragraphs.en: list_directory takes dir_path ; glob takes a pattern and optional dir_path . Both support filtering options. read_file takes file_path , with optional zero-based line offset and limit . It handles text, JSON, JSONL, YAML, and Markdown as text, returns numbered lines and continuation guidance, and directs image and video requests to the corresponding visual tools. A response is limited to 20,000 characters of numbered content; individual long lines are truncated. This interface provides access to task metadata, action traces, input logs, image indices, and any exported structured UI artifacts.

paragraphs.en: get_video_metadata takes file_path and reports metadata obtained with ffprobe . watch_video takes the video path and optional start_ms , end_ms , interval_ms , max_frames , and frame_width . It returns sampled images; defaults are a 5,000-ms interval, at most 12 frames, and a width of 1,280 pixels. The interval must be at least 100 ms and each call can request at most 20 frames. extract_video_frames instead takes a list of 1–20 timestamps_ms and an optional frame_width . Both use ffmpeg and return timestamp labels. Near the video end, the requested time can be adjusted backward to obtain a decodable frame; the label reports the sampling time used and the original request when adjusted. Finalization checks that metadata inspection preceded sampling for the same video path.
paragraphs.zh: get_video_metadata 接收 file_path，并报告通过 ffprobe 获取的元数据。watch_video 接收视频路径以及可选的 start_ms、end_ms、interval_ms、max_frames 和 frame_width。 它返回采样后的图像；默认设置为 5,000 毫秒的间隔、最多 12 帧以及 1,280 像素的宽度。 间隔必须至少为 100 毫秒，且每次调用最多可请求 20 帧。extract_video_frames 则接收一个包含 1–20 个 timestamps_ms 的列表以及可选的 frame_width。 两者都使用 ffmpeg，并返回时间戳标签。 在视频结尾附近，可将请求的时间向后调整以获取可解码的帧；标签会报告实际使用的采样时间以及调整后的原始请求。 最终化步骤会检查是否在对同一视频路径进行采样之前已执行了元数据检查。

paragraphs.en: write_file takes file_path and the complete content , creating or replacing a file. finalize_extraction takes no required arguments. It requires at least one skill, a recorded read of an input task.json , valid skill frontmatter and a nonempty body, a write_file call and a subsequent read_file call for every final skill, and the video-metadata ordering described above. Heuristic checks for fixed coordinates, local paths, and timestamps produce warnings rather than semantic correctness guarantees.

paragraphs.en: The launcher creates one NexAU agent with the system prompt, registered tools, and bundled skill-creator policy. paragraphs.en: The prompt instructs the agent to correct finalization errors and retry. finalize_extraction returns diagnostics on failure and atomically writes extraction-manifest.json on success. The launcher checks that finalization succeeded after the agent returns; an ordinary text response alone leaves the run incomplete. The runtime also writes configuration provenance, event logs, and a summary of status, timing, tool activity, and available token usage. Structural validation and recorded call ordering are enforced by code; the authoring policy’s requirements for evidence grounding, workflow completeness, and appropriate generalization remain instructions to the model.

paragraphs.en: We construct one Jitter variant for each original task, yielding 64 source–variant pairs. GPT-5.6-sol assists in generating the revised task instructions and corresponding evaluation criteria, followed by human verification. paragraphs.en: For MyPCBench, we use the official environment setup and evaluator. For OSWorld-Verified, we reuse the official task-specific evaluators to score the resulting environment states. Evaluators run after the agent terminates or reaches the maximum action budget. For partial MyPCBench rubrics, the task score is the fraction or weighted fraction of satisfied items according to the official implementation. Full score requires all rubric conditions. OSWorld-Verified evaluators can return partial scores. For both benchmarks, Score averages the evaluator outputs and scales the result to 0–100, while SR counts only tasks receiving full credit. This SR corresponds to MyPCBench’s perfect rate; OSWorld’s official mean-score aggregation, called “success rate” in its reporting script, is reported as Score in our tables. We store evaluator logs and final-state artifacts for every rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 MyPCBench，我们使用官方的环境设置和评估器。 对于 OSWorld-Verified，我们复用官方针对特定任务的评估器来对生成的环境状态进行评分。 在智能体终止或达到最大动作预算后，评估器开始运行。 对于部分 MyPCBench 评分标准，任务分数是根据官方实现中满足项的占比或加权占比计算的。 获得满分需要满足所有评分标准条件。 OSWorld-Verified 的评估器可以返回部分分数。 对于这两个基准测试，Score 会平均评估器的输出并将结果缩放至 0–100，而 SR 仅统计获得全部分数的任务。 该 SR 对应于 MyPCBench 的完美完成任务率；OSWorld 官方采用的平均分数聚合方法（在其报告脚本中称为“成功率”）在我们的表格中以 Score 的形式呈现。 我们为每次运行存储评估器日志和最终状态的相关产物。

paragraphs.en: No Skill (also labeled Baseline) provides no additional guidance. We evaluate ShowUI-Aloha and D2T as sources of guidance for the same downstream execution agent. paragraphs.en: The condition labeled w/o UI Annotations corresponds to the implementation’s without_dom protocol. paragraphs.en: This condition retains only the task instruction and ordered action captions in task.json and trace/actions.jsonl , respectively. paragraphs.en: The full skill in Appendix F.3 makes several relevant dependencies explicit. It carries booking values across searches, rechecks fields that may reset, excludes the primary restaurant from the fallback set, and selects the first two qualifying alternatives under the active ranking. It also defers final confirmation until the fallback steps are complete and checks both the reservation details and the saved favorites. These instructions organize the task into dependent stages with observable completion checks and explicit reminders of the secondary requirements across the primary reservation and fallback searches.
